about: The Issue 7 board's ICs as Acorn's Service Manual (D1) lists them in table 8.1, "Integrated circuits" (PDF pages 66 and 67, printed pages 56 and 57), transcribed by hand on 13 October 2026 from the page images: each IC's reference, its part as the table prints it, its place in mm from the board's SW corner as the table gives it (manualXY, task 5's check), and its role in our words where the table gives one. Task 4 added, before its nets check was run, the GND and +5V pins of the ICs that check uses, each with the data sheet it was read from (pinoutSourceId, an id in sources.json with the sheet's SHA-256); every other IC says why it is left out. The reasons were reworded after review on 13 October 2026, after the run, as documentation only: the set of ICs and every pin are as the run used them. Task 5 completes the file. Facts read from the sources named, not their text. Task 5 completed it on 13 October 2026: every IC's pins and package (pinsFrom says where from), a role for every IC (roleFrom: table 8.1, D1's circuit description by page, or what the part is by its type), the fitted set (fitted and fittedWhy: the Model B the page runs, with the 8271 disc interface and the DFS and without Econet or speech, each IC by the upgrade in D1 section 4 that fits it) and the paged ROMs (paged). The record of the fitted set is docs/bbc-micro/facts/models.md, "The fitted set".
pages: PDF pages 66 and 67 (printed pages 56 and 57), table 8.1
